ValidationRule.description: SCRUM-464 AC2: a third-party Case must name its manufacturer before it closes - the supplier renegotiation needs a name, not a comment. Refuses the value; the Case is not changed behind the user's back.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Was farab ein Fabrikant? Ist die Fall caused by a third-party product, pick the manufacturer from the list - the case cannot be closed without.
